name: Timestamp
description: Convert Unix timestamps and time zones.
chooseOffset: This local time occurs twice. Choose an offset.
copyFallback: Select the result and copy it manually.
nonexistentDst: This local time does not exist because of DST.

ambiguousUnitOverlay: This value is ambiguous between seconds and milliseconds. Pick a unit in the workbench.
outOfRange: The timestamp is outside the supported range.

invalidDate: Cannot parse the date-time; use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.
